mapper.select: SELECT a.iter, LPAD(a.num, CASE WHEN #{boxType} = 'zero' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END, '0') AS beforeNumber, LPAD(a.next_num, CASE WHEN #{boxType} = 'zero' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END, '0') AS afterNumber, LPAD(a.num + 1, CASE WHEN #{boxType} = 'zero' THEN 4 ELSE 3 END, '0') AS missingNumber FROM ( SELECT n.iter, n.num, LEAD(n.num) OVER (ORDER BY n.num) AS next_num FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT iter, CAST(box_number AS UNSIGNED) AS num FROM product_ids WHERE AND iter = ( SELECT MAX(iter) FROM product_ids WHERE ) ) n ) a JOIN ( SELECT iter, MIN(CAST(box_number AS UNSIGNED)) AS min_stocked, MAX(CAST(box_number AS UNSIGNED)) AS max_stocked FROM product_ids WHERE AND is_stocked = 1 GROUP BY iter ) stocked ON stocked.iter = a.iter WHERE a.next_num = a.num + 2 AND a.num + 1 BETWEEN stocked.min_stocked AND stocked.max_stocked ORDER BY a.num
